title: heliopsis buphthalmoides
intro: Heliopsis buphthalmoides, commonly known as False Sunflower, is a flowering plant native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Heliopsis buphthalmoides include acting as a vulnerary, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
